trends.name: Iran Conflict & Strait of Hormuz Shipping Crisis
trends.summary: Escalating Iran-US tensions and shipping disruptions through Strait of Hormuz are driving oil prices above $100 and threatening global energy infrastructure. Trump administration is taking unilateral stance with NATO allies refusing to provide support, creating geopolitical uncertainty. Market consensus signals oil could spike significantly if prices exceed $125.

trends.name: Oil & Energy Infrastructure Underinvestment
trends.summary: Energy executives highlighting critical underinvestment in infrastructure as demand surges and Iran crisis strains supplies. LNG sector attractive despite flat US gas prices; power needs driving gas infrastructure opportunities. Airlines raising revenue guidance despite fuel cost pressures, indicating demand resilience.

trends.name: Lululemon Proxy Battle & Tariff Headwinds
trends.summary: Lululemon stock falling sharply on weak guidance amid proxy battle complications and tariff pressures weighing on profitability. Signals need for major operational transformation in apparel sector facing dual macro and corporate governance challenges.

trends.name: Nvidia AI Momentum Plateauing After GTC
trends.summary: Nvidia's major GTC showcase failed to move stock meaningfully, raising questions about AI hype saturation and valuation concerns. Despite receiving China orders and restarting manufacturing, market reaction muted on traditional catalysts.

trends.name: OpenAI IPO Push & Productivity Focus
trends.summary: OpenAI preparing for IPO by end of 2026 with internal mandate that ChatGPT become a core productivity tool. Signals major shift toward commercialization and enterprise adoption as growth inflection strategy.

trends.name: Elon Musk-SEC Settlement Negotiations
trends.summary: Musk and SEC in active settlement talks over Twitter acquisition lawsuit, reducing regulatory overhang. Resolution could clear path for Tesla strategic initiatives and reduce executive distraction.

trends.name: Federal Reserve Rate Decision Uncertainty
trends.summary: Fed expected to issue interest rate decision this week amid stagflation concerns and elevated energy prices. Market positioning for potential policy shift as inflation pressures resurface from geopolitical shocks.

trends.name: Tesla Battery Supply Deal & EV Manufacturing
trends.summary: Tesla committing $4.3 billion to LG Energy battery cells from disbanded GM plant, signaling confidence in EV demand. Reflects supply chain consolidation and Tesla's manufacturing expansion strategy.

trends.name: Micron Semiconductor Rally & Valuation Milestone
trends.summary: Micron stock gains formally elevated company into exclusive high-valuation club, reflecting semiconductor sector strength. Indicates AI infrastructure demand translating into chip maker profitability and market confidence.

trends.name: Private Markets Sentiment Shift & Valuation Concerns
trends.summary: Orlando Bravo pushing back on private markets criticism while acknowledging some software names deserve valuation cuts due to AI disruption. Signals selective caution despite overall private equity confidence in deployment.

trends.name: Healthcare Cost Inflation: Medicare Premiums Doubling
trends.summary: Medicare premiums could double over next decade, threatening retirement budgets and signaling structural healthcare cost inflation. Major policy concern affecting consumer spending power and healthcare sector dynamics.

trends.name: Airlines Strong Demand Offsetting Fuel Costs
trends.summary: Airlines raising revenue guidance despite rising fuel costs, with American Airlines posting highest Q1 revenue growth in company history. Demonstrates robust demand resilience offsetting energy inflation headwinds.
